description:
Simple notes synced with your own CalDAV server, such as Radicale

DavNotes is a simple note app for Android. Your notes are stored as VJOURNAL entries in a CalDAV collection on your own server and synced both ways.

It works offline. Changes are saved on the phone right away and sent to the server as soon as you are online again.

Features

  • Create, edit, search and delete notes with a title, text and tags.
  • Light formatting written as Markdown: headings, bold, italic, lists and indentation, with a toolbar above the keyboard. Notes stay plain text that other apps can read.
  • Links in the text can be opened in the browser.
  • Open text and Markdown files as new notes, also via "Open with" and "Share", and share a note as a file.
  • Saves automatically while you type and when you leave a note.
  • Syncs when you open the app, after every change, with pull to refresh and about every 15 minutes.
  • Never overwrites a note blindly. If a note was changed both here and somewhere else, your version is saved as a new note with "(conflict)" in the title. Text is never merged.
  • Shares the collection with other clients, such as jtx Board via DAVx⁵. Properties set by other apps are kept unchanged when you edit a note.
  • Finds your collections on the server and can create a new notes collection.
  • The password is encrypted with a key in the Android Keystore. HTTPS only.
  • In English, Danish, German, French and Spanish.

Requirements

A CalDAV server that supports sync-collection (RFC 6578). DavNotes is developed and tested with Radicale 3.

No ads, no tracking, no accounts other than your own server.
